Package index

Overview

What the package is for, the order the steps happen in, and what it refuses to do quietly.

mysterymodel mysterymodel-package
mysterymodel: Opinionated Workflow for Clinical Prediction Models

Specify

What is being predicted, from which columns, and how the data divides. Written down and checked before anything is fitted.

mm_project()
Create a validated analysis configuration

Prepare

Eligibility with a ledger that reconciles, and a description that carries its denominators.

mm_clean()
Apply eligibility rules and account for every row that leaves
mm_eda()
Describe the cohort, with denominators and missingness

Fit and predict

The model, and risks from exactly that model.

mm_model()
Fit the declared model with rms
mm_predict()
Predict risk from exactly the fitted model

Validate

Performance on a stated basis, because apparent, bootstrap-corrected and held-out numbers are not interchangeable.

mm_validate()
Validate the model, on a stated basis

Present

A nomogram that is checked against the model it was drawn from.

mm_nomogram()
Draw the nomogram, and prove it agrees with the model

Data

mm_synthetic_cohort()
Generate a synthetic cohort resembling a urodynamics study
